name: aromir_pinv_scan
purpose: TASKS 236 step (1), 16 Nov 2026: for every corpus molecule with a geometry (about 1,180), the 3N-6-th and the next singular value of the Wilson B as aromir builds it, their ratio, and how many values numpy's default pinv cutoff keeps, on the Linux numpy build (2.5.4, OpenBLAS) where `np.linalg.pinv(B)` explodes for biphenyl+CN. It says how wide the gap is that a rank-based pseudo-inverse relies on and whether any molecule has a genuinely small non-null value. Read-only on the corpus. In WSL under probes/wsl_capped.sh so the live training (v14_stage1) cannot lose memory to it.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 2000 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(SCAN) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_dev/bin/python probes/results_m1/aromir_pinv_2026-11-16/scan_b_gap.py . probes/results_m1/aromir_pinv_2026-11-16/b_gap_scan_wsl.tsv probes/results_m1/aromir_pinv_2026-11-16/b_gap_scan_wsl.json"

estimate.basis: the 12-molecule smoke of 16 Nov took 8.8 s in WSL through /mnt/c, 0.7 s a molecule; 1,180 molecules, the larger ones slower

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 2000 MB; the 12-molecule smoke peaked at 0.32 GB
